hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"file_path\",json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"filePath\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qiE "\.(env|env\..*)$"; then echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"BLOCKED: Cannot edit credential files. Update .env.agents manually.\"}"; exit 0; fi; echo "{\"decision\":\"allow\"}"'

bash -c 'CMD=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE "(rm\s+-rf\s+(/|~|/\*|\.git)$|git\s+push.*--force.*(main|master)|DROP\s+TABLE|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE)"; then echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"BLOCKED: Destructive operation detected. Ask CC for confirmation first.\"}"; exit 0; fi; echo "{\"decision\":\"allow\"}"'

bash -c 'CMD=$(echo $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qiE "^(git\s+push|git\s+commit|npm\s+run\s+build|vercel\s+deploy)"; then echo "[HOOK] Logged: $CMD" >> /Users/conaugh/Downloads/business-empire-agent/tmp/hook_audit.log 2>/dev/null; fi'
osascript -e 'display notification "Bravo needs your attention." with title "Claude Code" sound name "Ping"' 2>/dev/null || true

bash -c 'cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && STALE=$(python scripts/memory_aging.py stale --days 7 --json 2>/dev/null | python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"stale_count\",0))" 2>/dev/null); if [ "$STALE" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "[STALENESS REPORT] $STALE memory entries are >7d old. Files with stale Last-updated: ACTIVE_TASKS.md, LONG_TERM.md, MISTAKES.md, PATTERNS.md (verify before quoting). Run: python scripts/memory_aging.py stale --days 7"; fi'
